title: Grafana docs style: avoid 'e.g.', 'see [', and 'self-hosted'
answers: What docs style should I use for Grafana datasource docs?
Should I write 'e.g.' or 'for example' in Grafana docs?
Should I use 'see' or 'refer to' for doc links?
body: Grafana docs writers-toolkit style, applied during quarterly doc reviews: use 'for example,' instead of 'e.g.,'; use 'Refer to [link]' instead of 'See [link]'; use 'self-managed' instead of 'self-hosted' when referring to non-Cloud Grafana installs. Seen applied across docs/sources/datasources/azure-monitor/*/index.md during a scheduled quarterly review pass.
applies: Prose edits to docs/sources/**/*.md under Grafana docs, especially during scheduled quarterly review passes
